analysis_method: Claude visual inspection of the full image

structural_characteristics.layout: Four ascending staircase columns (stages) growing left to right, each a tall dark panel with nested team groups.
structural_characteristics.reading_direction: Left-to-right by column height; no connectors.
structural_characteristics.hierarchy: Stage column > team pill > role pills > tool chips.

design_characteristics.color_treatment: Each column a different saturated gradient header (green, yellow, orange, red).
design_characteristics.typography: Large bold sans title; small labels inside dark pills.
design_characteristics.connectors: None between stages; dashed ellipse loop in last column.

content_capacity.observed: Very dense logo chips; small type at native size.

limitations: Staircase implies quantitative growth between stages, which is not in the source.
No taxonomy row pattern for 25 categories.
Low native resolution for this density.

evidence.observation: Four stage panels of increasing height with color-coded headers.

content_isolation: Reference text, names, logos, claims and creator branding are not carried into this run; only layout/design patterns are profiled.
